patch_description:
This implementation replaces the high-dimensional direct evolutionary search with a two-level constraint-bundle strategy. First, it searches a compact threefold-orbit family: one center point plus four rotated point orbits, with the outer orbit defining an equilateral convex hull. This substantially reduces the difficult global-search dimension while retaining asymmetric radial phases to avoid the collinearities caused by naïve rotational symmetry.

A deterministic cross-entropy search identifies promising orbit parameters using a lexicographic bottleneck-and-lower-tail objective. It then expands the best symmetric candidate into unrestricted interior points and applies active-constraint local refinement: proposals preferentially move vertices belonging to currently small triangles, while only accepting improvements to the true minimum area or its lower-tail tie-breaker. The outer hull remains fixed and all movable points are projected into the enclosing triangle.
